name: ESC-50 log-mel logistic baseline
features: 64 log-mel bands: mean/std/10th/90th percentile and delta std; 320 values
learning: Supervised training from scratch; not YAMNet or a deep neural network.
protocol: Single holdout, NOT five-fold CV. Train folds 1-3; validation 4 with source-overlap exclusions; test 5 intact.
license: ESC-50 CC BY-NC 3.0; preserve per-clip credits; noncommercial educational use.
warning_policy: Reference Python DEDA generalized to explicit dataset indices; only named configured events alert; all cues non-directional for mono input.
scope: Real dataset recognition; historical paper benchmark and Wokwi unchanged.
